sentences.en: For years, a mysterious company has been buying farmland on the outskirts of Silicon Valley, eventually putting together a plot twice the size of San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 多年来，一家神秘公司一直在硅谷郊外收购农田，最终拼凑出一块面积两倍于旧金山的土地。

sentences.en: But at every step, those behind the company kept their plans for the land shrouded in secrecy.
sentences.zh: 但在每一步中，这家公司背后的操盘手都将土地规划严密封锁，秘而不宣。

sentences.en: Until my colleague, Conor Doherty, figured out who they were and what they were up to.
sentences.zh: 直到我的同事康纳·多尔蒂查清了他们的身份和意图。

sentences.en: It's Monday, March 11th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月11日，星期一。

sentences.en: So Conor, this story begins as a real estate mystery that you took it upon yourself to try to crack wide open.
sentences.zh: 康纳，这个故事最初是一个房地产谜团，你主动承担起了解开谜底的任务。

sentences.en: So tell us about where this mystery unfolds.
sentences.zh: 那么，告诉我们这个谜团是在哪里展开的吧。

sentences.en: Okay, so if you imagine you're in San Francisco, and you drive north, further up into the Bay Area, into an area called Solano County.
sentences.zh: 好的，如果你想象自己身处旧金山，然后向北开车，进入湾区，到达一个叫索拉诺县的地方。

sentences.en: And then you go way east, and you end up in this very rural corner of the Bay Area that not a lot of people know about.
sentences.zh: 然后你再往东走很远，就会到达湾区一个非常偏僻的角落，没多少人知道那里。

sentences.en: And it's over here, in this rural corner of Solano County, where our story takes place.
sentences.zh: 我们的故事就发生在索拉诺县这个偏僻的角落里。

sentences.en: And it's this open, sort of rolling landscape of Yellow Hills with almost nothing on it.
sentences.zh: 那是一片开阔、起伏的黄色丘陵地带，几乎什么都没有。

sentences.en: The largest structures there are wind turbines.
sentences.zh: 那里最大的建筑就是风力涡轮机。

sentences.en: And a lot of the families out there are farmers.
sentences.zh: 那里的许多家庭都是农民。

sentences.en: They farm sheep, feed crops, and cows.
sentences.zh: 他们养羊、种饲料作物、养牛。

sentences.en: And many of the people out there have been there since like the 1860s.
sentences.zh: 许多人从1860年代起就住在那里了。

sentences.en: This is a place where families stay in the same place for generations and pass the farms down several times.
sentences.zh: 这是一个家庭世世代代居住在同一个地方，并将农场传承数代的地方。

sentences.en: This is a place where not a lot changes.
sentences.zh: 这是一个几乎没什么变化的地方。

sentences.en: But then, in 2017, something very unusual starts to happen.
sentences.zh: 但到了2017年，一些非常不寻常的事情开始发生了。

sentences.en: A company called Flannery Associates, which nobody in the area has ever heard of, starts buying land.
sentences.zh: 一家名为弗兰纳里联合公司的企业，当地没人听说过，开始收购土地。

sentences.en: And they buy more the next year, the year after that, the year after that, more and more and more and more.
sentences.zh: 第二年他们买得更多，再下一年，再下一年，越来越多，越来越多。

sentences.en: Until pretty quickly, they're the biggest landowner in the entire county.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，他们就成了整个县最大的地主。

sentences.en: So, all these neighbors are at supermarkets, they're at church, they're at schools.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些邻居们在超市、教堂、学校里碰面时都在谈论。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a place where everyone knows everyone.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个每个人都认识每个人的地方。

sentences.en: They're all on community boards together.
sentences.zh: 他们一起在社区委员会共事。

sentences.en: They all talk to each other all the time.
sentences.zh: 他们总是互相交谈。

sentences.en: They all sort of simultaneously get these offers for their land.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎同时收到了这些土地收购报价。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And like you said, they don't even know who the offer is coming from.
sentences.zh: 就像你说的，他们甚至不知道报价来自谁。

sentences.en: All they know is that a very aggressive, as we say in New York, highly motivated buyer is in their midSt.
sentences.zh: 他们只知道，用我们纽约的话说，一位非常有侵略性、动力十足的买家出现在他们中间。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Highly motivated buyer.
sentences.zh: 动力十足的买家。

sentences.en: So, they not only want everyone's farm, they start offering people these incredibly sweetheart deals,
sentences.zh: 所以，他们不仅想要每个人的农场，还开始提供极其优厚的条件，

sentences.en: which say, okay, well, I'm going to buy your land, but you can stay there for the next decade or two, depending on how old they are.
sentences.zh: 比如，好的，我要买你的地，但你可以继续住上十年或二十年，具体取决于他们的年龄。

sentences.en: And for all that time, you can collect all the income from this land.
sentences.zh: 而且在这段时间里，你还可以收取这片土地产生的所有收益。

sentences.en: I don't even want the income of the land.
sentences.zh: 我甚至都不想要那片土地的收益。

sentences.en: So, one thing everyone realizes pretty quickly is these people are not interested in farming.
sentences.zh: 所以，每个人很快意识到的一点是，这些人对务农根本不感兴趣。

sentences.en: Because if they wanted to farm, they would kick the farmers off the land they had just bought.
sentences.zh: 因为如果他们想务农，他们就会把农民从刚买下的土地上赶走。

sentences.en: Or they would want to make money from farming.
sentences.zh: 或者他们会想通过务农赚钱。

sentences.en: Like, they don't care about the price that reflects the income, and they don't even care about collecting the income.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不在乎反映收益的价格，甚至不在乎收取收益。

sentences.en: So, they very obviously have a plan that has nothing to do with farming.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，他们的计划与务农毫无关系。

sentences.en: And so, the question is, what's the plan?
sentences.zh: 那么问题来了，他们的计划是什么？

sentences.en: And who are these people?
sentences.zh: 这些人又是谁？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, then the county starts to get curious who this is.
sentences.zh: 于是，县政府开始好奇这到底是谁。

sentences.en: But because this Flannery Associates is incorporated in Delaware, which has some specific rules that kind of cloak who is behind a company, nobody can figure out who they are.
sentences.zh: 但由于弗兰纳里联合公司是在特拉华州注册的，那里有一些特殊的规定可以掩盖公司背后的实际控制人，所以没人能查出他们是谁。

sentences.en: And they send a bunch of letters to the company, Flannery Associates' lawyer.
sentences.zh: 他们给弗兰纳里联合公司的律师发了一堆信函。

sentences.en: And this lawyer kind of just puts them off and says, oh, don't worry about it.
sentences.zh: 而这位律师只是敷衍他们，说，哦，别担心。

sentences.en: This is a group of wealthy families who are looking to diversify their assets, and they just want to park it in farmland, basically.
sentences.zh: 这是一群想要分散资产的富裕家庭，他们基本上只是想把钱投在农田里。

sentences.en: Local mayors, concerned citizens are going down to the libraries and pulling property records and, you know, looking up corporate LLCs and stuff
sentences.zh: 当地市长和忧心忡忡的市民们跑去图书馆查阅房产记录，查找公司有限责任公司信息等等，

sentences.en: to sort of try to figure out who is behind this.
sentences.zh: 试图找出幕后黑手。

sentences.en: The county becomes very concerned about what is happening here.
sentences.zh: 县政府对这里发生的事情变得非常担忧。

sentences.en: There's this massive information vacuum, and people start to fill it.
sentences.zh: 这里出现了一个巨大的信息真空，人们开始试图填补它。

sentences.en: We're talking about Solano County, where the single largest landowner is now an LLC based in Delaware.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是索拉诺县，现在那里最大的单一地主是一家总部位于特拉华州的有限责任公司。

sentences.en: The group Flannery Associates has acquired tens of thousands of acres of dry farmland, equivalent to nearly double the size of San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 弗兰纳里联合公司已经收购了数万英亩的旱地农田，面积几乎是旧金山的两倍。

sentences.en: And no one knows why.
sentences.zh: 而且没人知道原因。

sentences.en: So whatever they are, I know what they are.
sentences.zh: 所以不管他们是什么，我知道他们不是什么。

sentences.en: They aren't buying carbon credits, you know.
sentences.zh: 他们不是在买碳信用额度，你知道的。

sentences.en: They have intentions that are outside of our usual land use ideas.
sentences.zh: 他们的意图超出了我们通常的土地使用观念。

sentences.en: That's what makes it scary, I guess, is that we know nothing about them.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是令人害怕的地方，我们对他们一无所知。

sentences.en: Now, there's an important detail here that I've sort of left out, which is...
sentences.zh: 现在，这里有一个重要的细节我刚才漏掉了，那就是……

sentences.en: A mysterious purchase of dry farmland near Travis Air Force Base, one of the most critical military bases in the Western U.S., has raised serious questions.
sentences.zh: 在特拉维斯空军基地附近神秘购买旱地农田的行为，引发了严重质疑，该基地是美国西部最关键的军事基地之一。

sentences.en: All of this land is near and surrounds Travis Air Force Base, which is a very important strategic air force base, sometimes called the Gateway to the Pacific.
sentences.zh: 所有这些土地都靠近并环绕着特拉维斯空军基地，这是一个非常重要的战略空军基地，有时被称为“通往太平洋的门户”。

sentences.en: And the concern is that a foreign actor of some kind, spies, basically, is buying up a bunch of land around an air force base.
sentences.zh: 人们担心某种外国势力，基本上就是间谍，正在空军基地周围大量收购土地。

sentences.en: That it may very well be Chinese money.
sentences.zh: 这很可能是中国的资金。

sentences.en: With the goal of surveilling it or something like that.
sentences.zh: 目的是为了监视基地之类的。

sentences.en: For an enemy to be able to be right next to the base, to monitor, to listen in to the communications, it would certainly be possible to do that if you own the land
sentences.zh: 如果敌人能就在基地旁边，进行监控、窃听通讯，如果你拥有紧邻特拉维斯空军基地围栏的土地，这当然是可能的。

sentences.en: adjacent to the fence line of Travis Air Force Base.
sentences.zh: 虽然从来没有任何证据，但考虑到这些土地围绕基地的地理位置……

sentences.zh: 没错。
